invariant: ADR-0158 U7 R1 (mirroring ADR-0144 D6, whose cube door stands beside this one): a dataset or cube measure of type `sum`, `avg`, `min` or `max` over a `unitMode: 'record'` quantity is refused INVALID_FIELD / 400 before either strategy reads anything, unless the query has a dimension whose column is that quantity's `unitField` on the same object. A time dimension or a `where` pinning one unit does not count: the rule is the grouping. `count` and `count_distinct` are not judged. It is asked on every `ensureCube` path and in the draft preview, after the record-currency door.
